sequence.module: Result Comparison / Outcome Evaluation controlled module
sequence.goal: produce typed expected/actual comparison, deviation and error candidates without mutation
sequence.exit_condition: comparison scenarios distinguish observation/prediction/decision/execution/world-change outcomes with reverse trace

sequence.module: A Route Runtime Product Loop Integration
sequence.goal: connect bounded user ingress, existing controlled owners, action/runtime boundary and result feedback
sequence.exit_condition: one product route can execute under explicit runtime policy and return a result candidate

sequence.module: User-facing Input/Output and Capability Runtime Gateway
sequence.goal: provide real bounded interaction and capability execution adapters
sequence.exit_condition: user can provide input, receive governed output, and trace execution/result

sequence.module: Runtime Attention and Evidence Feedback Integration
sequence.goal: connect attention demand, cost, information need, sufficiency and result comparison
sequence.exit_condition: attention can allocate/stop/redirect with explicit budget and no provider autonomy

sequence.goal: turn current contracts into bounded evidence-driven expectation and error feedback
sequence.exit_condition: competing expectations and prediction error route to controlled reconsideration

sequence.module: Computable Cognitive State and Regulation Integration
sequence.goal: only after product loop evidence exists, introduce bounded numeric state/update behavior
sequence.exit_condition: state update is specified, bounded, traceable, tested and still owner-safe

sequence.goal: admit bounded learning signals and human/self review without automatic mutation
sequence.exit_condition: learning adjustments remain reversible, reviewed, and non-automatic

sequence_rule: module-level construction; do not fragment into isolated schema phases
